details: This package is a self-declared dependency-confusion proof of concept. Its postinstall hook runs beacon.cjs, which sends an HTTP POST to hxxp://185[.]158[.]107[.]175:8787/_ah/dc carrying only install metadata: the package name, the machine hostname, the install directory, the working directory, and the npm/node version, tagged with an x-beacon-package header. index.js fires the same beacon when the module is required and exports a catch-all Proxy no-op shim so that a build importing the name completes instead of crashing. No credentials, environment values, tokens, or file contents are collected or transmitted, and there is no second-stage payload.
